name: Urgent care clinic
summary: Freestanding single-story walk-in clinic (≈3,000–6,000 SF) with exam rooms, procedure room, X-ray and point-of-care lab, usually on a retail pad with high visibility signage. No urgent-care-specific public benchmark was retrieved; cost is derived from medical office/clinic data with a small-building premium and a larger site share.

typicalSize.method: Judgment: typical freestanding urgent care prototypes 3,000–7,000 SF.

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Derived: 4,500-SF building on a 0.6–1.0 acre pad with ≈25–35 spaces.

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Spaces per GSF (judgment; walk-in demand peaks).

perPrimaryUnit.method: Derived from medical-office.json mid ($400, 2025). RSMeans 2019 models show the 1-story MOB at 1.03× the 2-story (e2 $217.02 vs e3 $210.81) — the small-building premium. Pad sitework is a larger share (≈$35–50/GSF vs ≈$30 for an MOB) but there are no elevators or multi-story structure. Net: $400 × 1.03 ≈ $410. Low/high follow the MOB range shifted ≈+$10; RSMeans clinic quartiles $188–330 (2022, e1) sit at the low end.

scope.notes: Contractor price incl. GC/fee, building + pad sitework; excludes X-ray equipment, furniture, land, soft costs, off-sites.

systemSplit.method: Derived from medical-office split with MEP per RSMeans clinic medians (plumbing 6.65%, mechanical 10.9%, electrical 11.4%, e1), X-ray shielding (13, 1%), and sitework raised to 15% for a pad site.

lineItems.name: Digital X-ray room (shielding + DR equipment)

cost.method: Derived judgment (no public source fetched): lead shielding/room prep ≈ $20k–50k + digital radiography system ≈ $80k–250k.

lineItems.notes: Imaging is in the catalog definition, so this is on by default.

cost.method: From _blocks/signage.json monument-sign (most urgent-care pads use monument signs; pylons are higher).
Derived: ≈0.8-acre pad with ≈30 stalls, utilities and landscaping ≈ $150k–300k spread over 4,500 SF.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Derived judgment: exam tables, procedure lights, lab analyzers, nurse station and waiting furniture (X-ray separate).

pctOfHard.method: Derived: A/E 7–9% (RSMeans medical models carry 9%), permits 1–2%, survey/geotech 1%, insurance/legal 2%, developer fee 3–5%; prototype designs reduce A/E.

softCosts.notes: Operator prototypes reduce design cost; state clinic licensing is minor.

design.method: Prototype-based designs need less design contingency.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Min ≈ RSMeans clinic 1/4 quartile escalated + pad sitework + 15% soft; max ≈ Cumming MOB high in high-cost metros ($690–750) × 1.2.

source.title: 2022 Project Costs — 50 17 00 Project Costs per S.F.

evidence.quote: Medical Clinics & Offices, Total Project Costs per S.F.: 1/4 = 188, Median = 250, 3/4 = 330 (Plumbing 6.65%, Mechanical 10.90%, Electrical 11.40% of total, medians).
evidence.scopeNotes: Completed medical clinics & offices, January 2022 national dollars, incl. contractor OH&P; sitework scope not stated.

source.title: Construction Cost Estimates for a Medical Office, 1 Story in National, US (2019 RSMeans data)

evidence.quote: Medical Office, 1 Story ... Floor Area (S.F.): 7,000 ... SubTotal 100% $173.62 ... Contractor Fees (General Conditions,Overhead,Profit) 25% $43.40 ... Architectural Fees 9% (union); open shop SubTotal $158.20
evidence.scopeNotes: Basic-component model, excl. sitework. Hard cost = SubTotal + 25% contractor fees (open $197.75, union $217.02). 2-story model: $191.90–$210.81.

source.title: Construction Cost Estimates for a Medical Office, 2 Story in National, US (2019 RSMeans data)

evidence.quote: Medical Office, 2 Story ... SubTotal 100% $168.65 ... Contractor Fees (General Conditions,Overhead,Profit) 25% $42.16 (union); open shop SubTotal $153.52
evidence.scopeNotes: Hard = SubTotal + contractor fees. Used with e2 for the 1-story/small-building premium (217.02/210.81 = 1.03).

source.title: Market Analysis Q4 2025 — Typical Construction Cost Range (Cost Per Unit 2025)

evidence.quote: Healthcare | Medical Office Building | SF: Dallas $450–$690; Nashville $400–$620; Denver $490–$750; Chicago $590–$900
evidence.scopeNotes: Values are the Dallas column; Nashville $400–620, Denver $490–750, 10-metro median $570–875. Cumming notes: "Costs represent new-build projects for complete structure shell and interior build-out to five feet out and excludes sitework." Excludes land, professional fees, permits, FF&E, soft costs.

openQuestions: No urgent-care-specific cost source retrieved; operator prototype budgets or municipal site-plan staff reports would validate the derived mid.
